name: OTB Property Command

product.purpose: Single-asset visual property command center with audit-grade data governance and AI assistance
product.property: On The Boulevard Shopping Center, 101-149 Arnould Blvd, Lafayette, LA 70506
product.operator: Adam Abdalla (Orange Ocean, LLC, managing Belle Realty of Lafayette, LLC)

stack.frontend: Vanilla JS ES modules + Vite 7, no framework, no router (DOM show/hide sheets)
stack.database: Supabase Postgres + Auth (magic link) + Storage (4 private buckets), RLS-enforced, no service-role key
stack.ai: Anthropic claude-opus-4-8 (agent desk), Claude Haiku (stall classifier)
stack.offlineTooling: Python (ezdxf/Pillow/openpyxl) + Node tools + PowerShell scheduled tasks

tiers: Supabase (property_state JSONB + normalized append-only tables + buckets)

automation.vercelCron: /api/auto-trigger daily 11:00 UTC (triggers, monthly brief, monthly rent charges — all idempotent)

extractionMethod: Full source read via 4 parallel exploration agents (views, lib/business-logic, data model, api/docs/architecture) + direct reads of HANDOFF.md, security-model.sql, vercel.json, tools/
